sites.name: Philae first touchdown (Agilkia)
sites.coordinateNote: Actual first touchdown, 112 m from the target point (335.00, +14.75). Latitude as stated: as stated (ESA flight dynamics nucleus frame, version 00085, used for the planned site).

sites.name: Philae final resting site (Abydos, Wosret region)
sites.coordinateNote: Preliminary 2016 OSIRIS identification refined this to 358.45, -8.15 (uncertain to about 3 m). Latitude as stated: as stated (approximate; same nucleus frame).
